shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git diff package.json && ls -a && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cat next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/lib/auth.ts tsconfig.json; grep -ril "forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/admin; grep -o '403\|Forbidden' /tmp/admin.html | sort | uniq -c; pkill -f "next start"; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/ | grep -i connection

npx next build 2>&1 | grep -A6 "^Route"; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/admin; grep -o 'Forbidden\|noindex' /tmp/admin.html | sort | uniq -c; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/; pkill -f "next start" || true

sed -i "s/role: 'user', \/\/ Not an admin/role: 'admin', \/\/ TEMP/" app/lib/auth.ts && npx next build >/dev/null 2>&1; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/admin; grep -o 'Welcome, [^<]*' /tmp/admin.html; pkill -f "next start"; sed -i "s/role: 'admin', \/\/ TEMP/role: 'user', \/\/ Not an admin/" app/lib/auth.ts; git diff --stat app/lib/auth.ts
git checkout app/lib/auth.ts && git diff tsconfig.json && grep -n "role: 'user'" app/lib/auth.ts && npx next build 2>&1 | grep "/admin"
